content.text:
**逻辑**操作符，也被称为**布尔**操作符。

其用于判断一个表达式返回**true**或**false**。

下面的表格，展示了逻辑运算符（**AND`&&`**, **OR`||`**, **NOT`!`**）的更多细节。

|操作符|作用|
|----|----|
|`&&`|若操作符左右两侧的值都为`true`，则逻辑表达式返回`true`，否则返回false|
|`||`|表达式两侧其中一个值为true，逻辑表达式就会返回`true`|
|`!`|若操作数右侧的值为`false`，则非操作逻辑表达式返回`true`，否则返回`false`|

resolved.title: 逻辑表达式
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Operators [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
Let's take a look at an example. Here we’ve connected two Boolean expressions with the [b]AND [/b]operator.
[code format="js" codeId="4834"](4 > 2) && (10 < 15)[/code]
For this expression to be [b]true[/b], both conditions need to be [b]true[/b].
- The first condition determines whether 4 is greater than 2, which is [b]true[/b]. 
- The second condition determines whether 10 is less than 15, which is also [b]true[/b]. 

Ta da! The whole expression is [b]true[/b]...very logical!

[s0l0!-header][h2]Conditional (Ternary) Operator[/h2][/s0l0!-header]
[b]Conditional[/b], or [b]Ternary[/b], [b]operators[/b] assign a value to a variable, based on some condition.

This is what the syntax would look like:
[s0l0!-header][b][/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" ]variable = (condition) ? value1: value2 [/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]And here’s an example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="4835"]var isAdult = (age < 18) ? "Too young": "Old enough";[/code]
If the variable age is a value below 18, the value of the variable isAdult will be "Too young". Otherwise the value of isAdult will be "Old enough". 
[s0l0!-coach id="419" name="Noon Or Midnight" xp="10" description="Given a clock that measures 24 hours in a day, write a program that takes the hour as input and ..." imageUrl="/content/assets/27dd9678dae01b7c728d.png" button="Start" color="ecdb68"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
With logical operators you can connect as many expressions as you want or need to.
[/note]

resolved.title: 上午或下午
resolved.problem_statement_md:
当你玩得开心时，时间过得很快。

写一个程序，输入小时数。

如果小时在0到12的范围内(包括0和12)，就向控制台输出**am**，否则输出**pm**。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical or boolean operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Time flies when you’re having fun.
Given a clock that measures 24 hours in a day, write a program that takes the hour as input. If the hour is in the range of 0 to 12, output [b]am [/b]to the console, and output [b]pm [/b]if it's not.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
13

[b]Sample Output[/b]
pm

[note]Assume the input number is positive and less than or equal to 24.
[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 设输入的数字是正数，并且小于或等于24。
